phase3_findings.description: The shared _TOO_DEEP_MESSAGE ('bundle JSON is too deeply nested to parse safely') names no limit and no remedy, unlike the sibling size and item caps; now that MAX_BUNDLE_DEPTH = 64 is documented, a CLI or MCP user does not learn the number they hit. The message is restated in docs/internal/agent/memory.md and docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md.

The sibling-walk test puts the deep branch in the last list item under the last key, so it catches a walk that follows only the first child but not one that follows only the last child (the natural mistake given the LIFO stack.pop() order in _enforce_depth_cap).

The MAX_BUNDLE_DEPTH cap is filed under 'Bundle-level DoS caps (parse-boundary, issue #186)'; the lead sentence says three caps 'refuse such payloads' (the many-cheap-items case the depth cap does not address) and the Field-constraint rationale fits only the item cap. Mirror instance: docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md line 419. Capped at Suggestion by the behavior-inert prose cap.
